title: Connect the log radar as a source of incidents
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** The radar's hot, new blips become events of kind `radar.blip` in the same format, in whichever host runs the radar. After CloudWatch and app events, per direction. See initiative kanbus-6f9fc4.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started.
